class.name: EditorDebuggerSession
class.brief_description: A class to interact with the editor debugger.
class.description: This class cannot be directly instantiated and must be retrieved via an [EditorDebuggerPlugin]. You can add tabs to the session UI via [method add_session_tab], send messages via [method send_message], and toggle [EngineProfiler]s via [method toggle_profiler].

method.name: debug_control
method.description: Routes pause, continue, step_into, step_over or step_out to this debugger session. Returns [constant ERR_BUSY] if the current break state does not allow the action.

method.name: request_stack_variables
method.description: Requests variables for a paused stack frame through the existing debug protocol. Results arrive through the stack frame signals.

method.name: add_session_tab
method.description: Adds the given [param control] to the debug session UI in the debugger bottom panel. The [param control]'s node name will be used as the tab title.

method.name: is_active
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the debug session is currently attached to a remote instance.

method.name: is_breaked
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the attached remote instance is currently in the debug loop.

method.name: is_debuggable
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the attached remote instance can be debugged.

method.name: remove_session_tab
method.description: Removes the given [param control] from the debug session UI in the debugger bottom panel.

method.name: send_message
method.description: Sends the given [param message] to the attached remote instance, optionally passing additionally [param data]. See [EngineDebugger] for how to retrieve those messages.

method.name: set_breakpoint
method.description: Enables or disables a specific breakpoint based on [param enabled], updating the Editor Breakpoint Panel accordingly.

method.name: toggle_profiler
method.description: Toggle the given [param profiler] on the attached remote instance, optionally passing additionally [param data]. See [EngineProfiler] for more details.

method.name: get_profiler_state
method.description: Returns enabled and a monotonic generation for outgoing profiler configuration messages. Automation can observe an existing human capture and must only disable a capture it still owns.

signal.name: profiler_frame
signal.description: Emitted for existing servers or visual profiler frames. Data uses the corresponding debugger marshaling format.

signal.name: break_reason
signal.description: The reason supplied when the session pauses.

signal.name: stack_frame_variable
signal.description: A variable encoded by the existing debugger marshaling protocol.

signal.name: stack_frame_variables_started
signal.description: The number of variables expected for the requested frame.

signal.name: stack_dump
signal.description: The current paused stack frames received from the debugger.

signal.name: breaked
signal.description: Emitted when the attached remote instance enters a break state. If [param can_debug] is [code]true[/code], the remote instance will enter the debug loop.

signal.name: continued
signal.description: Emitted when the attached remote instance exits a break state.

signal.name: started
signal.description: Emitted when a remote instance is attached to this session (i.e. the session becomes active).

signal.name: stopped
signal.description: Emitted when a remote instance is detached from this session (i.e. the session becomes inactive).
